notes: Corrected ten (s019): the accepted alignment gave it the supplied which under rule 31's postposed-article clause, but that clause is scoped to an article whose modifier is a prepositional phrase. Here the modifier is the participle dotheisan and the article governs the expressed head noun charin, which is rule 31's test for emptying it; which was given now stands whole on the participle headed on given. This also brings the verse into line with 1:14, where tou before enoikountos behind the expressed pneumatos is likewise unrepresented (rule 24).
No determiner question arises for charin: the ASV writes and grace with no article of its own, so rule 31's supplying clause has nothing to place on the noun.
The repeated us of called us was folded onto the participle as a rule 7 pronoun helper rather than marked added or joined to hemas.
A reference comparison will report the unrepresented ten as a disagreement; that report is not a correction.
